p68.title: Lyft enters Poland: Freenow becomes Lyft – what it means for fleets and drivers
p68.lead: Lyft, which has owned Freenow since 2025, will start replacing the Freenow brand in Poland in Q1 2027. Both apps will run in parallel for a while. The company aims to at least double its rides in Poland in 2027 and enter 15–20 more smaller cities. The change affects passengers, over 10,000 active drivers working with Freenow and the partner companies they drive for.
